no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no advisory committee convened to discuss this application because the application did not raise significant public health questions on the role of the drug in the diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment, or prevention of a disease and outside expertise was not necessary.

summary: No advisory committee was convened to review this application; the Summary Review (L165), Office Director memo (L12: "An FDA Advisory Committee Meeting was not held to discuss this application"), and Clinical Review (L1520) all state an AC meeting was not held for NDA208854. A separate June 11-12, 2014 general-matters meeting of the Anesthetic and Analgesic Drug Products Advisory Committee (AADPAC) addressed potential cardiovascular (MACE) risk for the whole PAMORA drug class, not this application specifically; per that class-wide discussion FDA required a postmarketing observational CV safety study, but the reviews do not tie any application-specific change to an AC held for this NDA.
